```{python}
#| context: setup
#| echo: false
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from FinStoch import VasicekModel, MertonJumpDiffusion, OrnsteinUhlenbeck

px = pd.read_parquet("data/prices.parquet")
ojs_define(dates=px.index.strftime("%Y-%m-%d").tolist(), prices={t: px[t].tolist() for t in px})

def calibrar(modelo, f, nombres):
    tab = {t: modelo.calibrate(f(px[t].values), dt=1 / 252) for t in px}
    return pd.DataFrame(tab).T.rename(columns=nombres).round(4)

tabV = calibrar(VasicekModel, lambda s: s, {"a": "κ", "mu": "θ", "sigma": "σ"})
tabO = calibrar(OrnsteinUhlenbeck, np.log, {"theta": "θ", "mu": "μ", "sigma": "σ"})
tabM = calibrar(MertonJumpDiffusion, lambda s: s,
                {"mu": "μ", "sigma": "σ", "lambda_j": "λ", "mu_j": "μ_J", "sigma_j": "σ_J"})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
lib = {
  const dt = 1 / 252;
  const sum = a => a.reduce((s, x) => s + x, 0);
  const mean = a => sum(a) / a.length;
  const sd = a => { const m = mean(a); return Math.sqrt(sum(a.map(x => (x - m) ** 2)) / (a.length - 1)); };
  const quantile = (s, q) => { const p = (s.length - 1) * q, i = Math.floor(p), j = Math.min(i + 1, s.length - 1); return s[i] + (s[j] - s[i]) * (p - i); };
  const iso = d => new Date(d).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const bisect = (a, v, right) => {
    let lo = 0, hi = a.length;
    while (lo < hi) { const m = (lo + hi) >> 1; if (right ? a[m] <= v : a[m] < v) lo = m + 1; else hi = m; }
    return lo;
  };
  const between = (from, to) => {
    const i1 = Math.min(Math.max(bisect(dates, iso(to), true) - 1, 30), dates.length - 1);
    return [Math.max(Math.min(bisect(dates, iso(from), false), i1 - 30), 0), i1];
  };
  const bdays = (start, n) => {
    const out = [start];
    let d = new Date(start + "T00:00:00Z");
    while (out.length < n + 1) { d = new Date(d.getTime() + 864e5); const w = d.getUTCDay(); if (w !== 0 && w !== 6) out.push(iso(d)); }
    return out;
  };
  const rng = seed => {
    let a = seed >>> 0;
    const u = () => { a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) >>> 0; let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), a | 1); t ^= t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), t | 61); return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296; };
    const z = () => Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(1 - u())) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * u());
    const pois = l => { const L = Math.exp(-l); let k = 0, p = u(); while (p > L) { k++; p *= u(); } return k; };
    return {u, z, pois};
  };
  const fmt = x => !isFinite(x) ? "—" : (x !== 0 && (Math.abs(x) >= 1e5 || Math.abs(x) < 1e-3)) ? x.toExponential(2) : x.toFixed(4);
  const ranges = [1, 3, 6].map(m => ({count: m, label: `${m}m`, step: "month", stepmode: "backward"}))
    .concat([{count: 1, label: "1a", step: "year", stepmode: "backward"}, {step: "all", label: "todo"}]);

  const plot = (data, layout = {}, height = 440) => {
    const div = document.createElement("div");
    div.style.width = "100%";
    const calcH = () => div.clientWidth < 520 ? Math.max(300, Math.round(height * 0.75)) : height;
    let drawn = false;
    const render = () => {
      if (!div.clientWidth) return;               // pestaña oculta o aún sin ancho: se dibuja al tener tamaño
      if (!drawn) {
        drawn = true;
        Plotly.newPlot(div, data, {height: calcH(), margin: {l: 55, r: 15, t: 20, b: 95}, hovermode: "x unified", legend: {orientation: "h", yanchor: "top", y: -0.3}, ...layout}, {responsive: true, displaylogo: false});
      } else Plotly.relayout(div, {autosize: true, height: calcH()});
    };
    if (window.ResizeObserver) new ResizeObserver(render).observe(div);
    else { let t = 0; const poll = () => { render(); if (!drawn && t++ < 600) requestAnimationFrame(poll); }; requestAnimationFrame(poll); }
    return div;
  };
  const table = (head, rows) => {
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.innerHTML = `<table class="table table-sm"><thead><tr>${head.map(h => `<th>${h}</th>`).join("")}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(r => `<tr>${r.map(c => `<td>${c}</td>`).join("")}</tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>`;
    return d;
  };

  const calibAR = x => {
    const X = x.slice(0, -1), Y = x.slice(1), n = X.length, mx = mean(X), my = mean(Y);
    let sxy = 0, sxx = 0, sst = 0;
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { sxy += (X[i] - mx) * (Y[i] - my); sxx += (X[i] - mx) ** 2; sst += (Y[i] - my) ** 2; }
    const b = sxy / sxx, a = my - b * mx;
    const sse = sum(Y.map((y, i) => (y - a - b * X[i]) ** 2));
    const reverting = b > 0 && b < 1;
    const kappa = reverting ? -Math.log(b) / dt : 1e-3;
    const level = reverting ? a / (1 - b) : mx;
    const s2 = sse / (n - 2);
    const sigma = reverting ? Math.sqrt(s2 * 2 * kappa / (1 - b * b)) : Math.sqrt(s2 / dt);
    return {X, Y, n, a, b, r2: 1 - sse / sst, reverting, kappa, level, sigma, halfLife: Math.log(2) / kappa * 252, lo: Math.min(...X), hi: Math.max(...X)};
  };
  const calibMerton = (logp, k) => {
    const r = logp.slice(1).map((v, i) => v - logp[i]);
    let m = mean(r), s = sd(r);
    for (let it = 0; it < 20; it++) {
      const d = r.filter(x => Math.abs(x - m) <= k * s);
      m = mean(d); s = sd(d);
    }
    const jump = r.map(x => Math.abs(x - m) > k * s);
    const J = r.filter((x, i) => jump[i]).map(x => x - m);
    const sigma = s / Math.sqrt(dt), lambda = J.length / (r.length * dt);
    const muJ = J.length ? mean(J) : 0, sigJ = J.length > 1 ? sd(J) : 0.02;
    const kk = Math.exp(muJ + sigJ ** 2 / 2) - 1;
    return {r, jump, m, s, k, sigma, lambda, muJ, sigJ, nJ: J.length, mu: m / dt + sigma ** 2 / 2 + lambda * kk};
  };

  const simMR = (x0, kappa, level, sigma, steps, n, seed, tf = x => x) => {
    const R = rng(seed), k = Math.max(kappa, 1e-6), e = Math.exp(-k * dt), s = sigma * Math.sqrt((1 - e * e) / (2 * k));
    return Array.from({length: n}, () => {
      const p = new Float64Array(steps + 1); p[0] = x0;
      for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) p[i + 1] = level + (p[i] - level) * e + s * R.z();
      return p.map(v => tf(v));
    });
  };
  const simMerton = (x0, q, steps, n, seed) => {
    const R = rng(seed), kk = Math.exp(q.muJ + q.sigJ ** 2 / 2) - 1;
    const drift = (q.mu - q.sigma ** 2 / 2 - q.lambda * kk) * dt, vol = q.sigma * Math.sqrt(dt);
    return Array.from({length: n}, () => {
      const p = new Float64Array(steps + 1); p[0] = x0;
      for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
        const N = R.pois(q.lambda * dt);
        p[i + 1] = p[i] + drift + vol * R.z() + (N ? N * q.muJ + Math.sqrt(N) * q.sigJ * R.z() : 0);
      }
      return p.map(v => Math.exp(v));
    });
  };
  const fan = paths => {
    const out = {mean: [], lo: [], hi: []};
    for (let i = 0; i < paths[0].length; i++) {
      const col = Float64Array.from(paths, p => p[i]).sort();
      out.mean.push(mean(col)); out.lo.push(quantile(col, 0.05)); out.hi.push(quantile(col, 0.95));
    }
    return out;
  };

  const simFigure = ({ticker, i0, i1, paths, level, levelName}) => {
    const steps = paths[0].length - 1, h = prices[ticker], fut = bdays(dates[i1], steps), f = fan(paths), px = [], py = [];
    paths.slice(0, 30).forEach(p => { for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) { px.push(fut[i]); py.push(p[i]); } px.push(null); py.push(null); });
    const data = [
      {x: dates.slice(0, i1 + 1), y: h.slice(0, i1 + 1), name: "Real (ventana de calibración)", line: {color: "black", width: 1.5}},
      {x: dates.slice(i1), y: h.slice(i1), name: "Real (posterior)", line: {color: "#d62728", width: 1.5}},
      {x: px, y: py, name: "Trayectorias (30)", line: {color: "rgba(120,120,120,0.35)", width: 0.7}, hoverinfo: "skip"},
      {x: fut, y: f.hi, name: "P95", line: {width: 0}, showlegend: false},
      {x: fut, y: f.lo, name: "Banda P5–P95", fill: "tonexty", fillcolor: "rgba(31,119,180,0.2)", line: {width: 0}},
      {x: fut, y: f.mean, name: "Media simulada", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ];
    if (level != null) data.push({x: [dates[i0], fut[steps]], y: [level, level], name: levelName, line: {color: "green", dash: "dash", width: 1}});
    return plot(data, {
      yaxis: {title: "USD"},
      xaxis: {range: [dates[Math.max(i0, i1 - 504)], fut[steps]], rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}},
      shapes: [{type: "rect", xref: "x", yref: "paper", x0: dates[i0], x1: dates[i1], y0: 0, y1: 1, fillcolor: "rgba(0,0,0,0.06)", line: {width: 0}, layer: "below"}],
      annotations: [{x: dates[i0], y: 1, xref: "x", yref: "paper", text: "ventana de calibración", showarrow: false, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "bottom"}]
    }, 500);
  };
  const arFigure = (c, xl, yl) => {
    const span = c.hi - c.lo, ends = [c.lo, c.hi];
    const data = [
      {x: c.X, y: c.Y, mode: "markers", name: "Pares (xₜ, xₜ₊₁)", marker: {size: 4, color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.5)"}},
      {x: ends, y: ends.map(v => c.a + c.b * v), mode: "lines", name: "Ajuste MCO", line: {color: "#d62728", width: 2}},
      {x: ends, y: ends, mode: "lines", name: "xₜ₊₁ = xₜ", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}
    ];
    if (c.reverting && c.level > c.lo - span && c.level < c.hi + span)
      data.push({x: [c.level], y: [c.level], mode: "markers", name: "Nivel de equilibrio", marker: {symbol: "x", size: 12, color: "green"}});
    return plot(data, {
      hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: xl}, yaxis: {title: yl},
      annotations: [{xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0.02, y: 0.98, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false, bgcolor: "white",
        text: `xₜ₊₁ = ${c.a.toFixed(3)} + ${c.b.toFixed(5)}·xₜ<br>R² = ${c.r2.toFixed(4)} · n = ${c.n}${c.reverting ? "" : "<br>b ≥ 1: sin reversión"}`}]
    }, 420);
  };
  const retFigure = (c, i0) => {
    const x = dates.slice(i0 + 1, i0 + 1 + c.r.length), pick = f => ({x: x.filter((_, i) => f(i)), y: c.r.filter((_, i) => f(i))});
    const line = (y, text) => ({type: "line", xref: "paper", x0: 0, x1: 1, y0: y, y1: y, line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}});
    return plot([
      {...pick(i => !c.jump[i]), mode: "markers", name: "Difusión", marker: {size: 3, color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.6)"}},
      {...pick(i => c.jump[i]), mode: "markers", name: `Saltos (${c.nJ})`, marker: {size: 7, color: "#d62728"}}
    ], {
      hovermode: "closest", yaxis: {title: "retorno log diario"},
      shapes: [line(c.m + c.k * c.s), line(c.m - c.k * c.s)],
      annotations: [{xref: "paper", x: 1, y: c.m + c.k * c.s, text: `+${c.k}σ`, showarrow: false, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "bottom"},
                    {xref: "paper", x: 1, y: c.m - c.k * c.s, text: `−${c.k}σ`, showarrow: false, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "top"}]
    }, 420);
  };
  const histFigure = (c) => {
    const bin = c.s / 4, N = c.r.length, lim = 6 * c.s, xs = Array.from({length: 241}, (_, i) => c.m - lim + i * lim / 120);
    return plot([
      {type: "histogram", x: c.r.filter((_, i) => !c.jump[i]), xbins: {size: bin}, name: "Difusión", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.6)"}},
      {type: "histogram", x: c.r.filter((_, i) => c.jump[i]), xbins: {size: bin}, name: "Saltos", marker: {color: "#d62728"}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(v => N * bin * Math.exp(-0.5 * ((v - c.m) / c.s) ** 2) / (c.s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))), mode: "lines", name: "Normal de la difusión", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ], {barmode: "stack", hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "retorno log diario"}, yaxis: {title: "frecuencia"}}, 420);
  };

  const priceFigure = (tks, mode, logy, ma) => {
    const data = [];
    tks.forEach(t => {
      const y = mode === "Base 100" ? prices[t].map(v => 100 * v / prices[t][0]) : prices[t];
      data.push({x: dates, y, name: t, line: {width: 1.5}});
      if (ma > 0) data.push({x: dates, y: y.map((_, i) => i + 1 < ma ? null : mean(y.slice(i + 1 - ma, i + 1))), name: `${t} · media ${ma}d`, line: {width: 1, dash: "dot"}});
    });
    return plot(data, {
      yaxis: {type: logy ? "log" : "linear", title: mode === "Base 100" ? "Base 100" : "USD"},
      xaxis: {rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}, rangeslider: {visible: true, thickness: 0.07}},
      legend: {orientation: "h", y: 1.1}
    }, 520);
  };
  const logret = t => prices[t].slice(1).map((v, i) => Math.log(v / prices[t][i]));
  const volFigure = tks => plot(tks.map(t => {
    const r = logret(t);
    return {x: dates.slice(22), y: r.map((_, i) => i < 21 ? null : sd(r.slice(i - 20, i + 1)) * Math.sqrt(252)).slice(21), name: t, line: {width: 1.5}};
  }), {yaxis: {title: "volatilidad anualizada", tickformat: ".0%"}, xaxis: {rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}}}, 380);
  const retHist = t => {
    const r = logret(t), m = mean(r), s = sd(r), bin = s / 4, lim = 6 * s, xs = Array.from({length: 241}, (_, i) => m - lim + i * lim / 120);
    return plot([
      {type: "histogram", x: r, xbins: {size: bin}, name: "Observado", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.6)"}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(v => r.length * bin * Math.exp(-0.5 * ((v - m) / s) ** 2) / (s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI))), mode: "lines", name: "Normal", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: `retorno log diario — ${t}`}, yaxis: {title: "frecuencia"}}, 380);
  };

  return {dt, between, rng, fmt, table, plot, ranges, mean, sd, sum, quantile, bdays, fan, iso, calibAR, calibMerton, simMR, simMerton, simFigure, arFigure, retFigure, histFigure, priceFigure, volFigure, retHist};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
lib2 = {
  const {dt, plot, table, fmt, mean, sd, sum, quantile, rng, ranges, bdays, iso} = lib;
  const nn = a => a.map(v => isFinite(v) ? v : null);
  const grid = (a, b, n) => Array.from({length: n}, (_, i) => a + (b - a) * i / (n - 1));
  const npdf = (x, m, s) => Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - m) / s) ** 2) / (s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
  const moments = a => { const m = mean(a), s = sd(a), n = a.length; return {m, s, skew: sum(a.map(x => ((x - m) / s) ** 3)) / n, kurt: sum(a.map(x => ((x - m) / s) ** 4)) / n - 3}; };

  // ---------- Black-Scholes, Merton (1976) y volatilidad implícita ----------
  const erf = z => {
    const a = Math.abs(z);
    if (a < 3) { let s = 0, t = a; for (let n = 0; n < 80; n++) { s += t / (2 * n + 1); t *= -a * a / (n + 1); } return Math.sign(z) * 2 / Math.sqrt(Math.PI) * s; }
    const e = Math.exp(-a * a) / (a * Math.sqrt(Math.PI)) * (1 - 1 / (2 * a * a) + 3 / (4 * a ** 4) - 15 / (8 * a ** 6));
    return Math.sign(z) * (1 - e);
  };
  const cnd = x => 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / Math.SQRT2));
  const bs = (S, K, T, r, s, call = true, q = 0) => {
    const d1 = (Math.log(S / K) + (r - q + s * s / 2) * T) / (s * Math.sqrt(T)), d2 = d1 - s * Math.sqrt(T);
    return call ? S * Math.exp(-q * T) * cnd(d1) - K * Math.exp(-r * T) * cnd(d2) : K * Math.exp(-r * T) * cnd(-d2) - S * Math.exp(-q * T) * cnd(-d1);
  };
  const iv = (price, S, K, T, r, call) => {
    let lo = 1e-4, hi = 5;
    if (!(price > bs(S, K, T, r, lo, call) + 1e-10 && price < bs(S, K, T, r, hi, call))) return null;
    for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) { const m = (lo + hi) / 2; if (bs(S, K, T, r, m, call) > price) hi = m; else lo = m; }
    return (lo + hi) / 2;
  };
  const lf = [0]; for (let i = 1; i < 400; i++) lf.push(lf[i - 1] + Math.log(i));
  const mertonCall = (S, K, T, r, q) => {
    const k = Math.exp(q.muJ + q.sigJ ** 2 / 2) - 1, lp = q.lambda * (1 + k), lt = lp * T;
    if (lt <= 0) return bs(S, K, T, r, q.sigma, true);
    let c = 0;
    for (let n = 0, nmax = Math.min(390, Math.ceil(lt + 10 * Math.sqrt(lt) + 20)); n <= nmax; n++)
      c += Math.exp(-lt + (n ? n * Math.log(lt) : 0) - lf[n]) * bs(S, K, T, r - q.lambda * k + n * (q.muJ + q.sigJ ** 2 / 2) / T, Math.sqrt(q.sigma ** 2 + n * q.sigJ ** 2 / T), true);
    return c;
  };
  const smile = (S, T, r, ms, callPrice) => ms.map(m => {
    const K = S * m, c = callPrice(K), call = K >= S * Math.exp(r * T);
    return iv(call ? c : c - S + K * Math.exp(-r * T), S, K, T, r, call);
  });
  const smileFigure = ({S, T, r, curves, flat}) => {
    const ms = grid(0.7, 1.3, 25);
    const data = curves.map(c => ({x: ms, y: smile(S, T, r, ms, K => mertonCall(S, K, T, r, c.q)), name: c.name, line: c.line}));
    data.push({x: [0.7, 1.3], y: [flat, flat], name: "Black-Scholes (σ difusiva)", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}});
    return plot(data, {xaxis: {title: "Moneyness K/S₀"}, yaxis: {title: "Volatilidad implícita", tickformat: ".0%"}}, 420);
  };

  // ---------- Diagnósticos de calibración AR(1) ----------
  const residuals = c => c.Y.map((y, i) => y - c.a - c.b * c.X[i]);
  const resHist = c => {
    const e = residuals(c), s = sd(e), bin = s / 4, lim = 4.5 * s, xs = grid(-lim, lim, 181);
    return plot([
      {type: "histogram", x: e, xbins: {size: bin}, name: "Residuos", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.6)"}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(v => e.length * bin * npdf(v, 0, s)), mode: "lines", name: "Normal", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "residuo εₜ"}, yaxis: {title: "frecuencia"}}, 380);
  };
  const acfFigure = c => {
    const e = residuals(c), m = mean(e), den = sum(e.map(v => (v - m) ** 2)), L = 20, band = 1.96 / Math.sqrt(e.length);
    const r = Array.from({length: L}, (_, k) => sum(e.slice(k + 1).map((v, i) => (v - m) * (e[i] - m))) / den);
    return plot([
      {type: "bar", x: Array.from({length: L}, (_, k) => k + 1), y: r, name: "ACF de residuos", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.7)"}},
      {x: [0.5, L + 0.5], y: [band, band], mode: "lines", name: "±1,96/√n", line: {color: "#d62728", dash: "dash", width: 1}},
      {x: [0.5, L + 0.5], y: [-band, -band], mode: "lines", showlegend: false, line: {color: "#d62728", dash: "dash", width: 1}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "rezago"}, yaxis: {title: "autocorrelación"}}, 380);
  };

  // ---------- Específicas: Vasicek / OU ----------
  const meanCurves = ({ticker, i1, x0, level, kappa, steps, tf, label}) => {
    const fut = bdays(dates[i1], steps), h = prices[ticker], a = Math.max(0, i1 - 252);
    const data = [
      {x: dates.slice(a, i1 + 1), y: h.slice(a, i1 + 1), name: "Real", line: {color: "black", width: 1.5}},
      {x: dates.slice(i1), y: h.slice(i1), name: "Real (posterior)", line: {color: "#d62728", width: 1.5}}
    ];
    [0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4].forEach(m => data.push({x: fut, y: fut.map((_, i) => tf(level + (x0 - level) * Math.exp(-m * kappa * i * dt))), name: `${label}×${m}`, line: {width: m === 1 ? 3 : 1.5, dash: m === 1 ? "solid" : "dot"}}));
    return plot(data, {yaxis: {title: "USD"}}, 420);
  };
  const termDist = (paths, pdf, xlabel, name) => {
    const T = Array.from(paths, p => p[p.length - 1]), s = Float64Array.from(T).sort();
    const lo = quantile(s, 0.002), hi = quantile(s, 0.998), xs = grid(lo, hi, 200);
    return plot([
      {type: "histogram", x: T, histnorm: "probability density", nbinsx: 50, name: "Monte Carlo", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.6)"}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(pdf), mode: "lines", name, line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: xlabel, range: [lo, hi]}, yaxis: {title: "densidad"}}, 420);
  };
  const passage = (paths, level, kappa) => {
    const steps = paths[0].length, side = Math.sign(paths[0][0] - level) || 1;
    const first = paths.map(p => { for (let i = 1; i < steps; i++) if ((p[i] - level) * side <= 0) return i; return Infinity; });
    const cdf = Array.from({length: steps}, (_, i) => first.filter(f => f <= i).length / paths.length);
    const shapes = [], hl = Math.log(2) / kappa * 252;
    if (hl < steps) shapes.push({type: "line", x0: hl, x1: hl, yref: "paper", y0: 0, y1: 1, line: {color: "green", dash: "dash", width: 1}});
    return plot([{x: cdf.map((_, i) => i), y: cdf, name: "P(haber cruzado el nivel)", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}],
      {xaxis: {title: "días desde el inicio de la simulación"}, yaxis: {title: "probabilidad acumulada", range: [0, 1]}, shapes,
       annotations: hl < steps ? [{x: hl, y: 1, yref: "paper", text: "vida media", showarrow: false, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top"}] : []}, 420);
  };

  // ---------- Específicas: Merton ----------
  const mertonDecomp = ({ticker, i1}, q, steps, seed) => {
    const R = rng(seed), S0 = prices[ticker][i1], kk = Math.exp(q.muJ + q.sigJ ** 2 / 2) - 1;
    const drift = (q.mu - q.sigma ** 2 / 2 - q.lambda * kk) * dt, vol = q.sigma * Math.sqrt(dt), fut = bdays(dates[i1], steps);
    let xd = 0, xj = 0; const P = [S0], D = [S0], jx = [], jy = [], jt = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
      const N = R.pois(q.lambda * dt); xd += drift + vol * R.z();
      const js = N ? N * q.muJ + Math.sqrt(N) * q.sigJ * R.z() : 0; xj += js;
      P.push(S0 * Math.exp(xd + xj)); D.push(S0 * Math.exp(xd));
      if (N) { jx.push(fut[i + 1]); jy.push(P[i + 1]); jt.push(`salto ${(100 * (Math.exp(js) - 1)).toFixed(1)}%`); }
    }
    return plot([
      {x: fut, y: D, name: "Solo difusión", line: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.8)", width: 1.5}},
      {x: fut, y: P, name: "Difusión + saltos", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}},
      {x: jx, y: jy, mode: "markers", name: `Saltos (${jx.length})`, text: jt, hoverinfo: "text+x", marker: {size: 9, color: "#d62728"}}
    ], {yaxis: {title: "USD"}}, 420);
  };
  const jumpSizes = (c, q) => {
    const J = c.r.filter((_, i) => c.jump[i]).map(x => x - c.m), bin = 0.01, xs = grid(-0.3, 0.3, 241);
    return plot([
      {type: "histogram", x: J, xbins: {size: bin}, name: `Saltos detectados (${J.length})`, marker: {color: "#d62728"}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(v => J.length * bin * npdf(v, q.muJ, q.sigJ)), mode: "lines", name: "N(μ_J, σ_J) usado", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "tamaño del salto (log)"}, yaxis: {title: "frecuencia"}}, 420);
  };

  // ---------- Herding en activos: CSAD de Chang, Cheng y Khorana (2000) ----------
  const inv = A => {
    const n = A.length, M = A.map((r, i) => [...r, ...Array.from({length: n}, (_, j) => +(i === j))]);
    for (let c = 0; c < n; c++) {
      let p = c; for (let r = c + 1; r < n; r++) if (Math.abs(M[r][c]) > Math.abs(M[p][c])) p = r;
      [M[c], M[p]] = [M[p], M[c]];
      const d = M[c][c]; for (let j = 0; j < 2 * n; j++) M[c][j] /= d;
      for (let r = 0; r < n; r++) if (r !== c) { const f = M[r][c]; for (let j = 0; j < 2 * n; j++) M[r][j] -= f * M[c][j]; }
    }
    return M.map(r => r.slice(n));
  };
  const ols = (X, y, L = 5) => {
    const n = y.length, k = X[0].length, z = () => Array.from({length: k}, () => new Array(k).fill(0));
    const XtX = z(), Xty = new Array(k).fill(0);
    for (let t = 0; t < n; t++) for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) { Xty[a] += X[t][a] * y[t]; for (let b = 0; b < k; b++) XtX[a][b] += X[t][a] * X[t][b]; }
    const I = inv(XtX), beta = I.map(row => sum(row.map((v, j) => v * Xty[j])));
    const e = y.map((v, t) => { let f = 0; for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) f += X[t][a] * beta[a]; return v - f; });
    const S = z();
    for (let l = 0; l <= L; l++) {
      const w = l === 0 ? 1 : 1 - l / (L + 1);
      for (let t = l; t < n; t++) { const g = w * e[t] * e[t - l];
        for (let a = 0; a < k; a++) for (let b = 0; b < k; b++) { const v = g * X[t][a] * X[t - l][b]; S[a][b] += v; if (l > 0) S[b][a] += v; } }
    }
    const cov = I.map((_, a) => I.map((__, b) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i < k; i++) for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) s += I[a][i] * S[i][j] * I[j][b]; return s; }));
    const my = mean(y), sst = sum(y.map(v => (v - my) ** 2));
    return {beta, t: beta.map((b, i) => b / Math.sqrt(cov[i][i])), r2: 1 - sum(e.map(v => v * v)) / sst, n};
  };
  const csadSeries = (tks, i0, i1) => {
    const T = i1 - i0, N = tks.length;
    const R = tks.map(t => Array.from({length: T}, (_, j) => Math.log(prices[t][i0 + 1 + j] / prices[t][i0 + j])));
    const rm = [], cs = [];
    for (let t = 0; t < T; t++) {
      let m = 0; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) m += R[i][t]; m /= N;
      let c = 0; for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) c += Math.abs(R[i][t] - m);
      rm.push(m); cs.push(c / N);
    }
    return {R, rm, cs, T, N, x: dates.slice(i0 + 1, i1 + 1)};
  };
  const cckX = rm => rm.map(m => [1, Math.abs(m), m * m]);
  const herdFit = s => {
    const pick = f => { const idx = s.rm.map((_, i) => i).filter(i => f(s.rm[i])); return ols(cckX(idx.map(i => s.rm[i])), idx.map(i => s.cs[i])); };
    const sorted = Float64Array.from(s.rm).sort(), lo = quantile(sorted, 0.05), hi = quantile(sorted, 0.95);
    const ext = ols(s.rm.map(m => [1, +(m <= lo), +(m >= hi)]), s.cs);
    return {all: ols(cckX(s.rm), s.cs), up: pick(m => m > 0), down: pick(m => m < 0), lin: ols(s.rm.map(m => [1, Math.abs(m)]), s.cs), ext, lo, hi};
  };
  const herdTables = f => {
    const row = (n, o) => [n, fmt(o.beta[0]), `${fmt(o.beta[1])} (${o.t[1].toFixed(2)})`, `${fmt(o.beta[2])} (${o.t[2].toFixed(2)})`, o.r2.toFixed(3), o.n, o.t[2] < -1.645 ? "sí" : "no"];
    const d = document.createElement("div");
    d.append(table(["Muestra", "α", "γ₁ (t)", "γ₂ (t)", "R²", "n", "Manada"], [row("Todos los días", f.all), row("Mercado al alza", f.up), row("Mercado a la baja", f.down)]));
    d.append(table(["Días extremos (5%)", "α", "β inferior (t)", "β superior (t)", "R²", "Manada"],
      [["CSAD", fmt(f.ext.beta[0]), `${fmt(f.ext.beta[1])} (${f.ext.t[1].toFixed(2)})`, `${fmt(f.ext.beta[2])} (${f.ext.t[2].toFixed(2)})`, f.ext.r2.toFixed(3), f.ext.t[1] < -1.645 && f.ext.t[2] < -1.645 ? "sí" : "no"]]));
    return d;
  };
  const herdScatter = (s, f) => {
    const lim = Math.max(...s.rm.map(Math.abs)), xs = grid(-lim, lim, 121), b = f.all.beta, l = f.lin.beta;
    return plot([
      {x: s.rm, y: s.cs, mode: "markers", name: "Días", marker: {size: 4, color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.5)"}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(m => b[0] + b[1] * Math.abs(m) + b[2] * m * m), mode: "lines", name: "Ajuste CCK (cuadrático)", line: {color: "#d62728", width: 2}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(m => l[0] + l[1] * Math.abs(m)), mode: "lines", name: "Benchmark lineal (sin manada)", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "retorno del mercado Rₘ (equiponderado)", tickformat: ".1%"}, yaxis: {title: "CSAD", tickformat: ".1%"},
        annotations: [{xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0.02, y: 0.98, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false, bgcolor: "white",
          text: `CSAD = ${b[0].toFixed(4)} + ${b[1].toFixed(3)}|Rₘ| ${b[2] < 0 ? "−" : "+"} ${Math.abs(b[2]).toFixed(2)}Rₘ²<br>γ₂ t = ${f.all.t[2].toFixed(2)} → ${f.all.t[2] < -1.645 ? "evidencia de manada" : "sin evidencia"}`}]}, 440);
  };
  const herdRolling = (s, W) => {
    const x = [], g = [], tt = [];
    for (let e = W - 1; e < s.T; e++) { const o = ols(cckX(s.rm.slice(e - W + 1, e + 1)), s.cs.slice(e - W + 1, e + 1), 3); x.push(s.x[e]); g.push(o.beta[2]); tt.push(o.t[2]); }
    return plot([
      {x, y: g, name: "γ₂ móvil", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 1.5}},
      {x: x.filter((_, i) => tt[i] < -1.645), y: g.filter((_, i) => tt[i] < -1.645), mode: "markers", name: "γ₂ < 0 significativo (t < −1,645)", marker: {size: 5, color: "#d62728"}},
      {x: [x[0], x[x.length - 1]], y: [0, 0], name: "γ₂ = 0", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}
    ], {yaxis: {title: "γ₂"}, xaxis: {rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}}}, 420);
  };
  const herdCorr = (s, W) => {
    const x = [], cr = [], cm = [];
    for (let e = W - 1; e < s.T; e++) {
      let tot = 0, cnt = 0;
      for (let i = 0; i < s.N; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < s.N; j++) {
        const a = s.R[i].slice(e - W + 1, e + 1), b = s.R[j].slice(e - W + 1, e + 1), ma = mean(a), mb = mean(b);
        let sab = 0, saa = 0, sbb = 0; for (let t = 0; t < W; t++) { sab += (a[t] - ma) * (b[t] - mb); saa += (a[t] - ma) ** 2; sbb += (b[t] - mb) ** 2; }
        tot += sab / Math.sqrt(saa * sbb); cnt++;
      }
      x.push(s.x[e]); cr.push(tot / cnt); cm.push(mean(s.cs.slice(e - W + 1, e + 1)));
    }
    return plot([
      {x, y: cm, name: "CSAD medio móvil", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 1.5}},
      {x, y: cr, name: "Correlación media entre activos", yaxis: "y2", line: {color: "#d62728", width: 1.5}}
    ], {yaxis: {title: "CSAD", tickformat: ".1%"}, yaxis2: {title: "correlación", overlaying: "y", side: "right", range: [0, 1]}, xaxis: {rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}}}, 420);
  };

  // ---------- Herding en opciones: modelo de Kirman (hormigas) + valoración Monte Carlo ----------
  const binom = (n, p, R) => {
    if (n <= 0 || p <= 0) return 0; if (p >= 1) return n;
    if (n < 30) { let c = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (R.u() < p) c++; return c; }
    return Math.max(0, Math.min(n, Math.round(n * p + Math.sqrt(n * p * (1 - p)) * R.z())));
  };
  const simHerd = (S0, q, steps, n, seed) => {
    const R = rng(seed), d = 1 / 252, paths = [], xs = [], xa = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < n; j++) {
      let k = Math.round(q.N / 2); const p = new Float64Array(steps + 1), x = new Float64Array(steps + 1);
      p[0] = S0; x[0] = k / q.N;
      for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
        const xi = k / q.N, up = binom(q.N - k, Math.min(1, q.eps + q.h * xi), R), dn = binom(k, Math.min(1, q.eps + q.h * (1 - xi)), R);
        k += up - dn;
        const m = 2 * k / q.N - 1, s = q.sigma * (1 + q.kappa * Math.abs(m));
        p[i + 1] = p[i] * Math.exp((q.r + q.beta * m - 0.5 * s * s) * d + s * Math.sqrt(d) * R.z());
        x[i + 1] = k / q.N;
      }
      paths.push(p); xa.push(x); if (j < 6) xs.push(x);
    }
    return {paths, xs, xa};
  };
  const statX = (q, seed) => {
    const R = rng(seed + 1), out = []; let k = Math.round(q.N / 2);
    for (let i = 0; i < 40000; i++) {
      const xi = k / q.N; k += binom(q.N - k, Math.min(1, q.eps + q.h * xi), R) - binom(k, Math.min(1, q.eps + q.h * (1 - xi)), R);
      if (i > 2000 && i % 5 === 0) out.push(k / q.N);
    }
    return out;
  };
  const lgamma = z => {
    const c = [0.99999999999980993, 676.5203681218851, -1259.1392167224028, 771.32342877765313, -176.61502916214059, 12.507343278686905, -0.13857109526572012, 9.9843695780195716e-6, 1.5056327351493116e-7];
    if (z < 0.5) return Math.log(Math.PI / Math.sin(Math.PI * z)) - lgamma(1 - z);
    z -= 1; let x = c[0]; for (let i = 1; i < 9; i++) x += c[i] / (z + i);
    const t = z + 7.5; return 0.5 * Math.log(2 * Math.PI) + (z + 0.5) * Math.log(t) - t + Math.log(x);
  };
  const herdX = xs => plot(xs.map((x, i) => ({x: Array.from(x, (_, t) => t), y: Array.from(x), name: `Trayectoria ${i + 1}`, line: {width: 1.2}})),
    {xaxis: {title: "días"}, yaxis: {title: "fracción de optimistas xₜ", range: [0, 1]}, shapes: [{type: "line", xref: "paper", x0: 0, x1: 1, y0: 0.5, y1: 0.5, line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}]}, 420);
  const herdStat = (q) => {
    const xs = statX(q, 7), a = q.N * q.eps / q.h, g = grid(0.005, 0.995, 199);
    return plot([
      {type: "histogram", x: xs, histnorm: "probability density", xbins: {start: 0, end: 1, size: 0.02}, name: "Simulado (largo plazo)", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.6)"}},
      {x: g, y: g.map(v => Math.min(10, Math.exp(lgamma(2 * a) - 2 * lgamma(a) + (a - 1) * Math.log(v * (1 - v))))), mode: "lines", name: `Beta(${a.toFixed(2)}, ${a.toFixed(2)})`, line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "fracción de optimistas x", range: [0, 1]}, yaxis: {title: "densidad"}}, 420);
  };
  const herdRet = (paths, S0) => {
    const r = Array.from(paths, p => Math.log(p[p.length - 1] / S0)), mo = moments(r), bin = mo.s / 5, xs = grid(mo.m - 4.5 * mo.s, mo.m + 4.5 * mo.s, 181);
    return plot([
      {type: "histogram", x: r, xbins: {size: bin}, name: "Retorno terminal simulado", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.6)"}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(v => r.length * bin * npdf(v, mo.m, mo.s)), mode: "lines", name: "Normal", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "ln(Sₜ/S₀)"}, yaxis: {title: "frecuencia"},
        annotations: [{xref: "paper", yref: "paper", x: 0.98, y: 0.98, xanchor: "right", yanchor: "top", showarrow: false, bgcolor: "white",
          text: `asimetría = ${mo.skew.toFixed(2)}<br>curtosis exceso = ${mo.kurt.toFixed(2)}`}]}, 420);
  };
  const herdPrices = (paths, S0, T, r, sigma) => {
    const F = S0 * Math.exp(r * T), ST = Float64Array.from(paths, p => p[p.length - 1]), adj = F / mean(ST);
    const price = (K, call) => Math.exp(-r * T) * mean(ST.map(v => Math.max(call ? v * adj - K : K - v * adj, 0)));
    const ms = grid(0.75, 1.25, 21);
    const ivs = ms.map(m => { const K = S0 * m, call = K >= F; return iv(price(K, call), S0, K, T, r, call); });
    return {price, ms, ivs, F, adj};
  };
  const herdSmile = (hp, sigma) => plot([
    {x: hp.ms, y: hp.ivs, name: "Con manada (Monte Carlo)", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}},
    {x: [hp.ms[0], hp.ms.at(-1)], y: [sigma, sigma], name: "Black-Scholes (σ base)", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}
  ], {xaxis: {title: "Moneyness K/S₀"}, yaxis: {title: "Volatilidad implícita", tickformat: ".0%"}}, 420);
  const herdOptTable = (hp, S0, T, r, sigma) => table(["K/S₀", "K", "Call MC", "Put MC", "Call BS", "Vol. implícita"],
    [0.8, 0.9, 1, 1.1, 1.2].map(m => { const K = S0 * m, call = K >= hp.F, v = iv(hp.price(K, call), S0, K, T, r, call);
      return [m.toFixed(2), fmt(K), fmt(hp.price(K, true)), fmt(hp.price(K, false)), fmt(bs(S0, K, T, r, sigma, true)), v == null ? "—" : (100 * v).toFixed(1) + "%"]; }));

  // ---------- Opciones reales: retículo binomial CRR ----------
  const lattice = (kind, V0, K, f, T, r, d, s, N) => {
    const h = T / N, u = Math.exp(s * Math.sqrt(h)), dn = 1 / u;
    const p = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, (Math.exp((r - d) * h) - dn) / (u - dn))), disc = Math.exp(-r * h);
    const pay = V => kind === "defer" ? Math.max(V - K, 0) : kind === "expand" ? Math.max((f - 1) * V - K, 0) : Math.max(K - V, 0);
    const Vn = (i, j) => V0 * Math.exp((2 * j - i) * s * Math.sqrt(h));
    const val = [], flag = [];
    val[N] = Array.from({length: N + 1}, (_, j) => pay(Vn(N, j))); flag[N] = val[N].map(v => v > 0);
    for (let i = N - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      val[i] = []; flag[i] = [];
      for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) { const c = disc * (p * val[i + 1][j + 1] + (1 - p) * val[i + 1][j]), e = pay(Vn(i, j)); flag[i][j] = e > c + 1e-12; val[i][j] = Math.max(c, e); }
    }
    return {value: val[0][0], val, flag, Vn, h, p, pay};
  };
  const realStatic = (kind, V, K) => kind === "defer" ? V - K : V;
  const realFlex = (kind, V, opt, K) => kind === "defer" ? opt : V + opt;
  const critical = (kind, q) => {
    const ref = Math.max(q.V0, q.K), at = V => lattice(kind, V, q.K, q.f, q.T, q.r, q.d, q.s, q.N).flag[0][0];
    const g = grid(0.2 * ref, 3 * ref, 150), ex = g.map(at);
    let i = kind === "abandon" ? ex.lastIndexOf(true) : ex.indexOf(true);
    if (i < 0) return null;
    let a = kind === "abandon" ? g[i] : g[Math.max(i - 1, 0)], b = kind === "abandon" ? g[Math.min(i + 1, g.length - 1)] : g[i];
    for (let it = 0; it < 25; it++) { const m = (a + b) / 2; if ((at(m) === true) === (kind !== "abandon")) b = m; else a = m; }
    return (a + b) / 2;
  };
  const msThreshold = (K, r, d, s) => {
    const m = (r - d) / (s * s) - 0.5, beta = -m + Math.sqrt(m * m + 2 * r / (s * s));
    return beta > 1 + 1e-9 ? beta / (beta - 1) * K : Infinity;
  };
  const kindName = {defer: "Diferir (call americana)", expand: "Expandir", abandon: "Abandonar (put americana)"};
  const realCurves = (kind, q, vstar) => {
    const ref = Math.max(q.V0, q.K), Vs = grid(0.2 * ref, 2.2 * ref, 70);
    const opt = Vs.map(V => lattice(kind, V, q.K, q.f, q.T, q.r, q.d, q.s, q.N).value);
    const shapes = [{type: "line", x0: q.V0, x1: q.V0, yref: "paper", y0: 0, y1: 1, line: {color: "black", dash: "dot", width: 1}}];
    if (vstar != null) shapes.push({type: "line", x0: vstar, x1: vstar, yref: "paper", y0: 0, y1: 1, line: {color: "green", dash: "dash", width: 1}});
    return plot([
      {x: Vs, y: Vs.map(V => realStatic(kind, V, q.K)), name: kind === "defer" ? "VPN estático (V − K)" : "Proyecto sin flexibilidad (V)", line: {color: "black", width: 1.5}},
      {x: Vs, y: Vs.map((V, i) => realFlex(kind, V, opt[i], q.K)), name: "Valor con la opción real", line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2.5}},
      {x: Vs, y: opt, name: "Valor de la opción", line: {color: "#d62728", width: 1.5, dash: "dot"}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "Valor presente de los flujos V"}, yaxis: {title: "valor"}, shapes,

  };

    for (let i = 0; i <= M; i++) for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) {

      (L.flag[i][j] ? ex : co).x.push(t); (L.flag[i][j] ? ex : co).y.push(V); (L.flag[i][j] ? ex : co).text.push(txt);
      if (i < M) { nx.push(t, t + L.h, null, t, t + L.h, null); ny.push(V, L.Vn(i + 1, j + 1), null, V, L.Vn(i + 1, j), null); }

        {xaxis: {title: "plazo de la opción T (años)"}, yaxis: {title: "valor de la opción"}}, 420)

      ["Europea Black-Scholes (referencia)", bsRef == null ? "—" : fmt(bsRef)],
```

```{ojs}
    const ms = R.map(mean), ss = R.map((r, i) => Math.sqrt(sum(r.map(v => (v - ms[i]) ** 2))));
    const z = R.map((a, i) => R.map((b, j) => { let s = 0; for (let t = 0; t < a.length; t++) s += (a[t] - ms[i]) * (b[t] - ms[j]); return s / (ss[i] * ss[j]); }));
    const off = []; z.forEach((row, i) => row.forEach((v, j) => { if (i !== j) off.push(v); }));
    return plot([{type: "heatmap", x: labels, y: labels, z, zmin: Math.min(...off), zmax: 1, colorscale: "Blues", texttemplate: "%{z:.2f}", hovertemplate: "%{y} vs %{x}: %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>"}],
      {hovermode: "closest", yaxis: {autorange: "reversed"}, margin: {l: 55, r: 15, t: 20, b: 40}}, 440);
  };
  const csadDeciles = (s, f) => {
    const n = s.T, idx = Array.from({length: n}, (_, i) => i).sort((i, j) => Math.abs(s.rm[i]) - Math.abs(s.rm[j])), nb = 10, per = Math.floor(n / nb), lab = [], cs = [], am = [], fit = [];
    for (let b = 0; b < nb; b++) {
      const ii = idx.slice(b * per, b === nb - 1 ? n : (b + 1) * per), a = mean(ii.map(i => Math.abs(s.rm[i])));
      lab.push(`D${b + 1}`); am.push(a); cs.push(mean(ii.map(i => s.cs[i]))); fit.push(f.all.beta[0] + f.all.beta[1] * a + f.all.beta[2] * mean(ii.map(i => s.rm[i] ** 2)));
    }
    return plot([
      {type: "bar", x: lab, y: cs, name: "CSAD medio observado", marker: {color: C.grey}, customdata: am, hovertemplate: "decil %{x}<br>|Rm| medio %{customdata:.2%}<br>CSAD medio %{y:.3%}<extra></extra>"},
      {x: lab, y: fit, mode: "lines+markers", name: "Ajuste CCK (cuadrático)", line: {color: C.red, width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "decil de |Rm| (D1 = calma, D10 = extremo)"}, yaxis: {title: "CSAD medio", tickformat: ".1%"}}, 420);
  };
  const herdScatterDate = (s, f) => {
    const lim = Math.max(...s.rm.map(Math.abs)), xs = grid(-lim, lim, 121), b = f.all.beta, yr = s.x.map(d => +d.slice(0, 4) + (+d.slice(5, 7) - 1) / 12);
    return plot([
      {x: s.rm, y: s.cs, mode: "markers", name: "Días", text: s.x, hovertemplate: "%{text}<br>Rm %{x:.2%}<br>CSAD %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>",
       marker: {size: 5, color: yr, colorscale: "Turbo", colorbar: {title: "año", tickformat: "d", dtick: 1}}},
      {x: xs, y: xs.map(m => b[0] + b[1] * Math.abs(m) + b[2] * m * m), mode: "lines", name: "Ajuste CCK", line: {color: "black", width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "retorno del mercado Rₘ", tickformat: ".1%"}, yaxis: {title: "CSAD", tickformat: ".1%"}}, 420);
  };
  const herdTimeline = (s, f) => {
    const ext = s.rm.map((m, i) => (m <= f.lo || m >= f.hi) ? i : -1).filter(i => i >= 0);
    return plot([
      {x: s.x, y: s.cs, name: "CSAD", line: {color: C.blue, width: 1.3}},
      {x: s.x, y: s.rm, name: "Rm (eje der.)", yaxis: "y2", line: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.45)", width: 1}},
      {x: ext.map(i => s.x[i]), y: ext.map(i => s.rm[i]), name: "Días extremos (5%)", yaxis: "y2", mode: "markers", marker: {size: 5, color: C.red}}
    ], {yaxis: {title: "CSAD", tickformat: ".1%"}, yaxis2: {title: "Rm", overlaying: "y", side: "right", tickformat: ".0%", automargin: true}, xaxis: {rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}}}, 420);
  };
  const herdRollT = (s, W) => {
    const x = [], t = [];
    for (let e = W - 1; e < s.T; e++) { const rm = s.rm.slice(e - W + 1, e + 1), o = ols(rm.map(m => [1, Math.abs(m), m * m]), s.cs.slice(e - W + 1, e + 1), 3); x.push(s.x[e]); t.push(o.t[2]); }
    const sig = t.map(v => v < -1.645);
    return plot([
      {x, y: t, name: "t(γ₂) móvil", line: {color: C.blue, width: 1.5}},
      {x: x.filter((_, i) => sig[i]), y: t.filter((_, i) => sig[i]), mode: "markers", name: "significativo (t < −1,645)", marker: {size: 5, color: C.red}},
      {x: [x[0], x[x.length - 1]], y: [-1.645, -1.645], name: "umbral −1,645", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}
    ], {yaxis: {title: "t de Newey-West de γ₂"}, xaxis: {rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}},
        annotations: [note(`ventanas con manada: ${pct(sig.filter(Boolean).length / sig.length)}`)]}, 420);
  };
  const herdBox = (s, f) => {
    const g = fn => s.cs.filter((_, i) => fn(s.rm[i])), mk = (name, y, color) => ({type: "box", y, name, boxmean: true, boxpoints: false, marker: {color}});
    return plot([mk("Mercado a la baja", g(m => m < 0), C.red), mk("Mercado al alza", g(m => m > 0), C.blue), mk("Caída extrema (P5)", g(m => m <= f.lo), "#8c1c1d"), mk("Alza extrema (P95)", g(m => m >= f.hi), "#0f4a72")],

  };

    const steps = xa[0].length, qs = [0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95], out = qs.map(() => new Array(steps)), mu = new Array(steps);
    for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) { const col = Float64Array.from(xa, x => x[i]).sort(); qs.forEach((q, k) => { out[k][i] = quantile(col, q); }); mu[i] = mean(col); }
    const t = Array.from({length: steps}, (_, i) => i);
    return plot([
      {x: t, y: out[4], line: {width: 0}, showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "skip"},
      {x: t, y: out[0], name: "Banda P5–P95", fill: "tonexty", fillcolor: "rgba(31,119,180,0.15)", line: {width: 0}},
      {x: t, y: out[3], line: {width: 0}, showlegend: false, hoverinfo: "skip"},
      {x: t, y: out[1], name: "Banda P25–P75", fill: "tonexty", fillcolor: "rgba(31,119,180,0.3)", line: {width: 0}},
      {x: t, y: out[2], name: "Mediana", line: {color: C.blue, width: 2}},
      {x: t, y: mu, name: "Media", line: {color: C.red, width: 1.5, dash: "dot"}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "días"}, yaxis: {title: "fracción de optimistas x", range: [0, 1]}, shapes: [{type: "line", xref: "paper", x0: 0, x1: 1, y0: 0.5, y1: 0.5, line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}]}, 420);
  };
  const herdXR = (sim, S0) => {
    const xT = sim.xa.map(x => x[x.length - 1]), R = sim.paths.map(p => Math.log(p[p.length - 1] / S0)), nb = 10, bx = [], by = [];
    for (let b = 0; b < nb; b++) {
      const idx = xT.map((_, i) => i).filter(i => xT[i] >= b / nb && (xT[i] < (b + 1) / nb || b === nb - 1));
      if (idx.length > 3) { bx.push(mean(idx.map(i => xT[i]))); by.push(mean(idx.map(i => R[i]))); }
    }
    return plot([
      {x: xT, y: R, mode: "markers", name: "Trayectorias", marker: {size: 4, color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.35)"}, hovertemplate: "x_T %{x:.2f}<br>ln(S_T/S₀) %{y:.2%}<extra></extra>"},
      {x: bx, y: by, mode: "lines+markers", name: "Media por decil de x_T", line: {color: C.red, width: 2}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "fracción de optimistas al vencimiento x_T", range: [0, 1]}, yaxis: {title: "ln(S_T/S₀)", tickformat: ".0%"}}, 420);
  };
  const herdSurface = ({paths, S0, r, steps}) => {
    const ts = [1 / 6, 2 / 6, 3 / 6, 4 / 6, 5 / 6, 1].map(f => Math.max(5, Math.round(f * steps))), ms = grid(0.8, 1.2, 9);
    const z = ts.map(t => {
      const T = t / 252, F = S0 * Math.exp(r * T), ST = Float64Array.from(paths, p => p[t]), adj = F / mean(ST);
      return ms.map(m => { const K = S0 * m, call = K >= F; return iv(Math.exp(-r * T) * mean(ST.map(v => Math.max(call ? v * adj - K : K - v * adj, 0))), S0, K, T, r, call); });
    });
    return plot([{type: "surface", x: ms, y: ts, z, colorscale: "Viridis", colorbar: {title: "vol. impl.", tickformat: ".0%"}, hovertemplate: "K/S₀ %{x:.2f}<br>%{y} días<br>σ impl. %{z:.1%}<extra></extra>"}],
      {hovermode: "closest", margin: {l: 0, r: 0, t: 10, b: 0}, scene: {xaxis: {title: "K/S₀"}, yaxis: {title: "vencimiento (días)"}, zaxis: {title: "σ implícita", tickformat: ".0%"}, camera: {eye: {x: 1.6, y: -1.6, z: 0.9}}}}, 460);
  };
  const herdPriceCurves = (hp, S0, T, r, sigma) => {
    const ms = grid(0.75, 1.25, 26), Ks = ms.map(m => S0 * m);
    return plot([
      {x: ms, y: Ks.map(K => hp.price(K, true)), name: "Call · Monte Carlo", line: {color: C.blue, width: 2}},
      {x: ms, y: Ks.map(K => bs(S0, K, T, r, sigma, true)), name: "Call · Black-Scholes", line: {color: C.blue, width: 1.5, dash: "dash"}},
      {x: ms, y: Ks.map(K => hp.price(K, false)), name: "Put · Monte Carlo", line: {color: C.red, width: 2}},
      {x: ms, y: Ks.map(K => bs(S0, K, T, r, sigma, false)), name: "Put · Black-Scholes", line: {color: C.red, width: 1.5, dash: "dash"}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "Moneyness K/S₀"}, yaxis: {title: "prima (USD)"}}, 420);
  };
  const herdKurtH = ({S0, q, steps, n, seed}) => {
    const hs = grid(0.02, 0.5, 10), nn = Math.min(n, 500);
    const res = hs.map(h => { const sim = simHerd(S0, {...q, h}, steps, nn, seed), mo = moments(sim.paths.map(p => Math.log(p[p.length - 1] / S0))); return {idx: q.N * q.eps / h, ...mo}; });
    return plot([
      {x: hs, y: res.map(r => r.kurt), name: "Curtosis en exceso", mode: "lines+markers", customdata: res.map(r => r.idx), hovertemplate: "%{y:.2f} (índice N·ε/h = %{customdata:.2f})", line: {color: C.blue, width: 2}},
      {x: hs, y: res.map(r => r.skew), name: "Asimetría", mode: "lines+markers", line: {color: C.red, width: 2}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "intensidad de imitación h"}, yaxis: {title: "momento del retorno terminal"}, shapes: [{...vline(q.h), x0: q.h, x1: q.h}],
        annotations: [{x: q.h, y: 1, yref: "paper", text: "h usado", showarrow: false, xanchor: "left", yanchor: "top", bgcolor: "white"}]}, 420);
  };
  const herdAcf2 = (paths, ticker, i0, i1) => {
    const L = 20, acfOf = x => { const n = x.length, m = mean(x); let den = 0; for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) den += (x[i] - m) ** 2;
      return Array.from({length: L}, (_, k) => { let s = 0; for (let i = 0; i + k + 1 < n; i++) s += (x[i + k + 1] - m) * (x[i] - m); return s / den; }); };
    const sim = new Array(L).fill(0), use = paths.slice(0, 200);
    use.forEach(p => { const r = []; for (let i = 0; i < p.length - 1; i++) { const v = Math.log(p[i + 1] / p[i]); r.push(v * v); } acfOf(r).forEach((v, k) => { sim[k] += v / use.length; }); });
    const h = prices[ticker].slice(i0, i1 + 1), real = acfOf(h.slice(1).map((v, i) => Math.log(v / h[i]) ** 2)), band = 1.96 / Math.sqrt(h.length - 1), lags = Array.from({length: L}, (_, k) => k + 1);
    return plot([
      {type: "bar", x: lags, y: real, name: "Histórico del ticker (ventana)", marker: {color: "rgba(80,80,80,0.55)"}},
      {x: lags, y: sim, mode: "lines+markers", name: "Simulado con manada", line: {color: C.blue, width: 2}},
      {x: [0.5, L + 0.5], y: [band, band], name: "±1,96/√n", line: {color: C.red, dash: "dash", width: 1}},
      {x: [0.5, L + 0.5], y: [-band, -band], showlegend: false, line: {color: C.red, dash: "dash", width: 1}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "rezago (días)"}, yaxis: {title: "autocorrelación de r²"}}, 420);
  };

  // ---------- Opciones reales ----------
  const realBoundary = (kind, q) => {
    const L = lattice(kind, q.V0, q.K, q.f, q.T, q.r, q.d, q.s, q.N), t = [], b = [], ref = Math.max(q.V0, q.K), top = kind === "abandon" ? 0 : 2.2 * ref;
    for (let i = 0; i <= q.N; i++) {
      let best = null;
      for (let j = 0; j <= i; j++) if (L.flag[i][j]) { const V = L.Vn(i, j); if (best == null || (kind === "abandon" ? V > best : V < best)) best = V; }
      t.push(i * L.h); b.push(best);
    }
    const thr = kind === "expand" ? q.K / Math.max(q.f - 1, 1e-9) : q.K;
    return plot([
      {x: t, y: b, name: "Frontera de ejercicio V*(t)", line: {color: C.red, width: 2, shape: "hv"}},
      {x: t, y: t.map(() => top), name: "Región de ejercicio", fill: "tonexty", fillcolor: "rgba(214,39,40,0.12)", line: {width: 0}, hoverinfo: "skip"},
      {x: [0, q.T], y: [thr, thr], name: kind === "expand" ? "K/(f−1)" : "K", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}},
      {x: [0, q.T], y: [q.V0, q.V0], name: "V₀", line: {color: C.blue, dash: "dot", width: 1}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "tiempo (años)"}, yaxis: {title: "valor del proyecto V", range: [0, 2.2 * ref]}}, 420);
  };
  const realDist = (kind, q) => {
    const m = Math.log(q.V0) + (q.r - q.d - q.s ** 2 / 2) * q.T, s = q.s * Math.sqrt(q.T), thr = kind === "expand" ? q.K / Math.max(q.f - 1, 1e-9) : q.K;
    const Vs = grid(Math.exp(m - 3.5 * s), Math.exp(m + 3.5 * s), 200), pdf = V => Math.exp(-0.5 * ((Math.log(V) - m) / s) ** 2) / (V * s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
    const above = kind !== "abandon", inEx = V => above ? V >= thr : V <= thr, pEx = above ? 1 - cnd((Math.log(thr) - m) / s) : cnd((Math.log(thr) - m) / s);
    const part = f => Vs.filter(f);
    return plot([
      {x: part(inEx), y: part(inEx).map(pdf), name: "Región de ejercicio", fill: "tozeroy", fillcolor: "rgba(214,39,40,0.25)", line: {color: C.red, width: 1}},
      {x: part(V => !inEx(V)), y: part(V => !inEx(V)).map(pdf), name: "Región de no ejercicio", fill: "tozeroy", fillcolor: "rgba(31,119,180,0.2)", line: {color: C.blue, width: 1}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "valor del proyecto al plazo V_T (medida neutral al riesgo)"}, yaxis: {title: "densidad"}, shapes: [{...vline(thr, "black"), x0: thr, x1: thr}],
        annotations: [note(`P(ejercer al plazo) = ${pct(pEx)}<br>E[V_T] = ${fmt(q.V0 * Math.exp((q.r - q.d) * q.T))}`)]}, 420);
  };
  const realTornado = (kind, q) => {
    const n = Math.min(q.N, 60), val = o => lattice(kind, o.V0, o.K, o.f, o.T, o.r, o.d, o.s, n).value, base = val(q);
    const ps = [["V₀", "V0"], ["K", "K"], ["σ", "s"], ["T", "T"], ["r", "r"], ["δ", "d"]].concat(kind === "expand" ? [["f", "f"]] : []);
    const rows = ps.map(([lab, key]) => { const lo = val({...q, [key]: q[key] * 0.8}), hi = val({...q, [key]: q[key] * 1.2}); return {lab: `${lab} (${fmt(q[key])})`, lo: lo - base, hi: hi - base}; })
      .sort((a, b) => Math.max(Math.abs(a.lo), Math.abs(a.hi)) - Math.max(Math.abs(b.lo), Math.abs(b.hi)));
    return plot([
      {type: "bar", orientation: "h", y: rows.map(r => r.lab), x: rows.map(r => r.lo), name: "−20 %", marker: {color: C.blue}},
      {type: "bar", orientation: "h", y: rows.map(r => r.lab), x: rows.map(r => r.hi), name: "+20 %", marker: {color: C.red}}
    ], {barmode: "overlay", hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: `cambio en el valor de la opción (base ${fmt(base)})`}, margin: {l: 110, r: 15, t: 20, b: 40}}, 420);
  };
  const realHeat = (kind, q) => {
    const ref = Math.max(q.V0, q.K), n = Math.min(q.N, 40), Vs = grid(0.3 * ref, 2 * ref, 28), ss = grid(0.05, 0.8, 22);
    const z = ss.map(s => Vs.map(V => lattice(kind, V, q.K, q.f, q.T, q.r, q.d, s, n).value));
    return plot([
      {type: "heatmap", x: Vs, y: ss, z, colorscale: "Viridis", colorbar: {title: "valor"}, hovertemplate: "V %{x:.0f}<br>σ %{y:.0%}<br>valor %{z:.2f}<extra></extra>"},
      {x: [q.V0], y: [q.s], mode: "markers", name: "parámetros usados", marker: {symbol: "x", size: 13, color: "white", line: {color: "black", width: 1}}}
    ], {hovermode: "closest", xaxis: {title: "valor presente de los flujos V"}, yaxis: {title: "volatilidad σ", tickformat: ".0%"}}, 420);
  };
  const realSigmaCurves = (kind, q) => {
    const ref = Math.max(q.V0, q.K), n = Math.min(q.N, 50), Vs = grid(0.2 * ref, 2.2 * ref, 50), L0 = lattice(kind, q.V0, q.K, q.f, q.T, q.r, q.d, q.s, n);
    const data = [{x: Vs, y: Vs.map(V => L0.pay(V)), name: "Pago inmediato", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}];
    [0.5, 1, 1.5, 2].forEach(mult => { const s = Math.min(1.5, q.s * mult);
      data.push({x: Vs, y: Vs.map(V => lattice(kind, V, q.K, q.f, q.T, q.r, q.d, s, n).value), name: `σ = ${pct(s)}${mult === 1 ? " (usada)" : ""}`, line: {width: mult === 1 ? 3 : 1.5}}); });
    return plot(data, {xaxis: {title: "valor presente de los flujos V"}, yaxis: {title: "valor de la opción"}, shapes: [{...vline(q.V0, "black"), x0: q.V0, x1: q.V0}]}, 420);
  };
  const realDelta = (kind, q) => {
    const ref = Math.max(q.V0, q.K), n = Math.min(q.N, 80), Vs = grid(0.2 * ref, 2.2 * ref, 80), dv = Vs[1] - Vs[0];
    const val = Vs.map(V => lattice(kind, V, q.K, q.f, q.T, q.r, q.d, q.s, n).value), m = val.length;
    const del = val.map((_, i) => i === 0 ? (val[1] - val[0]) / dv : i === m - 1 ? (val[i] - val[i - 1]) / dv : (val[i + 1] - val[i - 1]) / (2 * dv));
    const thr = kind === "expand" ? q.K / Math.max(q.f - 1, 1e-9) : q.K, step = kind === "defer" ? 1 : kind === "expand" ? q.f - 1 : -1;
    return plot([
      {x: Vs, y: del, name: "Δ de la opción (∂opción/∂V)", line: {color: C.blue, width: 2.5}},
      {x: Vs, y: Vs.map(V => (kind === "abandon" ? V < thr : V > thr) ? step : 0), name: "Δ del pago inmediato", line: {color: "black", dash: "dash", width: 1}}
    ], {xaxis: {title: "valor presente de los flujos V"}, yaxis: {title: "delta (unidades de V cubiertas)"}, shapes: [{...vline(q.V0, "black"), x0: q.V0, x1: q.V0}]}, 420);
  };

  // ---------- Precio histórico ----------
  const drawdown = tks => plot(tks.map(t => { let mx = -Infinity; const y = prices[t].map(v => { mx = Math.max(mx, v); return v / mx - 1; }); return {x: dates, y, name: t, line: {width: 1.4}, fill: tks.length === 1 ? "tozeroy" : "none"}; }),
    {yaxis: {title: "caída desde el máximo", tickformat: ".0%"}, xaxis: {rangeselector: {buttons: ranges}}}, 380);
  const riskReturn = sel => {
    const S = Object.keys(prices).map(t => { const r = logret(t); return {t, ret: mean(r) * 252, vol: sd(r) * Math.sqrt(252)}; }), on = t => sel.includes(t);
    return plot([{x: S.map(s => s.vol), y: S.map(s => s.ret), text: S.map(s => s.t), mode: "markers+text", textposition: "top center", marker: {size: S.map(s => on(s.t) ? 15 : 9), color: S.map(s => on(s.t) ? C.red : C.grey)},
      hovertemplate: "%{text}<br>vol %{x:.1%}<br>retorno log anual %{y:.1%}<extra></extra>"}], {hovermode: "closest", showlegend: false, xaxis: {title: "volatilidad anualizada", tickformat: ".0%"}, yaxis: {title: "retorno log medio anualizado", tickformat: ".0%"}}, 420);
  };
  const retQQ = t => qq(logret(t), {label: `retorno log diario ${t}`, text: dates.slice(1)});
  const retCorr = sel => { const tks = sel.length >= 2 ? sel : Object.keys(prices); return corrHeat(tks.map(logret), tks); };

  return {qq, acfLevel, riskFigure, passageHist, fanExact, mrHeat, negProb, rolling, rollFigure, mertonDensity, jumpCounts, kSensitivity, mertonSurface,
    corrHeat, csadDeciles, herdScatterDate, herdTimeline, herdRollT, herdBox, herdFan, herdXR, herdSurface, herdPriceCurves, herdKurtH, herdAcf2,
    realBoundary, realDist, realTornado, realHeat, realSigmaCurves, realDelta, drawdown, riskReturn, retQQ, retCorr};
}
```

# Vasicek

## {.sidebar}

**Calibración**

```{ojs}
viewof sV = Inputs.form({
  ticker: Inputs.select(tickers, {label: "Ticker"}),
  from: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar desde", value: dates[0], min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  to: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar hasta", value: "2023-12-31", min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)})
})
```

**Simulación**

```{ojs}
viewof gV = Inputs.form({
  horizon: Inputs.range([20, 504], {label: "Horizonte (días)", step: 1, value: 252}),
  n: Inputs.range([10, 1000], {label: "Trayectorias", step: 10, value: 200}),
  seed: Inputs.number({label: "Semilla", value: 42, step: 1})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cV = {
  const [i0, i1] = lib.between(sV.from, sV.to);
  return {i0, i1, ...lib.calibAR(prices[sV.ticker].slice(i0, i1 + 1))};
}
```

**Parámetros de la simulación** (arrancan en lo calibrado; muévelos para probar otras configuraciones)

```{ojs}
viewof pV = {
  const pad = 0.5 * (cV.hi - cV.lo);
  return Inputs.form({
    kappa: Inputs.range([0.001, Math.max(3 * cV.kappa, 5)], {label: "κ (velocidad)", value: cV.kappa}),
    theta: Inputs.range([Math.min(cV.level, cV.lo) - pad, Math.max(cV.level, cV.hi) + pad], {label: "θ (nivel)", value: cV.level}),
    sigma: Inputs.range([0.1 * cV.sigma, 3 * cV.sigma], {label: "σ", value: cV.sigma})
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
simV = lib.simMR(prices[sV.ticker][cV.i1], pV.kappa, pV.theta, pV.sigma, gV.horizon, gV.n, gV.seed)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
rollV = lib3.rolling(prices[sV.ticker])
```

## Row

Modelo: `dP = κ(θ − P)dt + σ dW` sobre el precio. **Calibración:** regresión MCO `Pₜ₊₁ = a + b·Pₜ + ε` sobre la ventana elegida; de ahí `κ = −ln(b)/Δt`, `θ = a/(1−b)`, `σ = s_ε·√(2κ/(1−b²))`. El punto verde es donde la recta ajustada corta la diagonal: el nivel de equilibrio θ. **Simulación:** esquema exacto del proceso desde el último precio de la ventana; si hay datos reales posteriores se dibujan en rojo para evaluar el ajuste fuera de muestra. Si `b ≥ 1` no hay reversión a la media y κ, θ no son identificables.

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Calibración: regresión Pₜ₊₁ sobre Pₜ"
//| width: 65%
lib.arFigure(cV, "Pₜ (USD)", "Pₜ₊₁ (USD)")
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Parámetros"
//| width: 35%
lib.table(["", "Calibrado", "Usado"], [
  ["κ", lib.fmt(cV.kappa), lib.fmt(pV.kappa)],
  ["θ", lib.fmt(cV.level), lib.fmt(pV.theta)],
  ["σ", lib.fmt(cV.sigma), lib.fmt(pV.sigma)],
  ["Vida media (días)", lib.fmt(Math.log(2) / cV.kappa * 252), lib.fmt(Math.log(2) / pV.kappa * 252)],
  ["b (AR1)", lib.fmt(cV.b), ""],
  ["R²", lib.fmt(cV.r2), ""],
  ["Reversión", cV.reverting ? "sí" : "no (b ≥ 1)", ""]
])
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Simulación Monte Carlo vs. precio real"
lib.simFigure({ticker: sV.ticker, i0: cV.i0, i1: cV.i1, level: pV.theta, levelName: "θ", paths: simV})
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Efecto de κ: media condicional E[Pₜ] con distintas velocidades de reversión"
//| width: 50%
lib2.meanCurves({ticker: sV.ticker, i1: cV.i1, x0: prices[sV.ticker][cV.i1], level: pV.theta, kappa: pV.kappa, steps: gV.horizon, tf: x => x, label: "κ"})
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Precio al horizonte: Monte Carlo vs. distribución normal analítica"
//| width: 50%
{
  const T = gV.horizon / 252, P0 = prices[sV.ticker][cV.i1], k = Math.max(pV.kappa, 1e-6);
  const m = pV.theta + (P0 - pV.theta) * Math.exp(-k * T), s = pV.sigma * Math.sqrt((1 - Math.exp(-2 * k * T)) / (2 * k));
  return lib2.termDist(simV, y => Math.exp(-0.5 * ((y - m) / s) ** 2) / (s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)), "Precio al horizonte (USD)", `Normal analítica (μ=${m.toFixed(1)}, σ=${s.toFixed(1)})`);
}
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| width: 50%
lib2.resHist(cV)
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Diagnóstico: autocorrelación de los residuos"
//| width: 50%

```

## Row

```{ojs}
lib3.fanExact({ticker: sV.ticker, i1: cV.i1, steps: gV.horizon,
  mf: t => pV.theta + (prices[sV.ticker][cV.i1] - pV.theta) * Math.exp(-Math.max(pV.kappa, 1e-6) * t),
  sf: t => pV.sigma * Math.sqrt((1 - Math.exp(-2 * Math.max(pV.kappa, 1e-6) * t)) / (2 * Math.max(pV.kappa, 1e-6)))})
```




```{ojs}

```


```{ojs}
//| width: 50%

```



# Merton

## {.sidebar}

**Calibración**

```{ojs}
viewof sM = Inputs.form({
  ticker: Inputs.select(tickers, {label: "Ticker"}),
  from: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar desde", value: dates[0], min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  to: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar hasta", value: "2023-12-31", min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  k: Inputs.range([1.5, 6], {label: "Umbral de saltos (×σ)", step: 0.1, value: 3})
})
```

**Simulación**

```{ojs}
viewof gM = Inputs.form({
  r: Inputs.range([0, 0.1], {label: "Tasa libre de riesgo (opciones)", step: 0.005, value: 0.04}),
  horizon: Inputs.range([20, 504], {label: "Horizonte (días)", step: 1, value: 252}),
  n: Inputs.range([10, 1000], {label: "Trayectorias", step: 10, value: 200}),
  seed: Inputs.number({label: "Semilla", value: 42, step: 1})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cM = {
  const [i0, i1] = lib.between(sM.from, sM.to);
  return {i0, i1, ...lib.calibMerton(prices[sM.ticker].slice(i0, i1 + 1).map(v => Math.log(v)), sM.k)};
}
```

**Parámetros de la simulación** (arrancan en lo calibrado)

```{ojs}
viewof pM = Inputs.form({
  mu: Inputs.range([Math.min(-0.5, cM.mu - 0.2), Math.max(0.5, cM.mu + 0.2)], {label: "μ (deriva anual)", value: cM.mu}),
  sigma: Inputs.range([0.01, Math.max(1, 2 * cM.sigma)], {label: "σ (difusión)", value: Math.max(cM.sigma, 0.01)}),
  lambda: Inputs.range([0, Math.max(30, 2 * cM.lambda)], {label: "λ (saltos/año)", value: cM.lambda}),
  muJ: Inputs.range([Math.min(-0.3, cM.muJ - 0.1), Math.max(0.3, cM.muJ + 0.1)], {label: "μ_J (salto medio)", value: cM.muJ}),
  sigJ: Inputs.range([0.001, Math.max(0.2, 2 * cM.sigJ)], {label: "σ_J (dispersión)", value: Math.max(cM.sigJ, 0.001)})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
simM = lib.simMerton(Math.log(prices[sM.ticker][cM.i1]), pM, gM.horizon, gM.n, gM.seed)
```

## Row

Modelo: `dS/S = (μ − λk)dt + σ dW + (J − 1)dN`, con `N` Poisson de intensidad λ y `ln J ~ N(μ_J, σ_J²)`. **Calibración (detección de saltos):** se parte de la media y desviación de los retornos log; se marcan como saltos los retornos a más de `k·σ` de la media, se re-estiman media y σ sin ellos y se repite hasta converger. Con los saltos detectados: `λ = n_saltos / años`, `μ_J` y `σ_J` = media y desviación del tamaño de los saltos, `σ` = desviación de la parte difusiva (anualizada) y `μ` recupera la deriva incluyendo la compensación `λk`. Subir el umbral detecta menos saltos.

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Calibración: retornos log y umbral de saltos"
//| width: 50%
lib.retFigure(cM, cM.i0)
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Distribución: difusión + saltos vs. normal"
//| width: 50%
lib.histFigure(cM)
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Parámetros"
//| width: 35%
lib.table(["", "Calibrado", "Usado"], [
  ["μ", lib.fmt(cM.mu), lib.fmt(pM.mu)],
  ["σ", lib.fmt(cM.sigma), lib.fmt(pM.sigma)],
  ["λ", lib.fmt(cM.lambda), lib.fmt(pM.lambda)],
  ["μ_J", lib.fmt(cM.muJ), lib.fmt(pM.muJ)],
  ["σ_J", lib.fmt(cM.sigJ), lib.fmt(pM.sigJ)],
  ["Saltos detectados", cM.nJ, ""],
  ["Umbral diario (k·σ)", lib.fmt(cM.k * cM.s), ""]
])
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Simulación Monte Carlo vs. precio real"
//| width: 65%
lib.simFigure({ticker: sM.ticker, i0: cM.i0, i1: cM.i1, level: null, levelName: "", paths: simM})
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Una trayectoria descompuesta: difusión vs. saltos"
//| width: 50%
lib2.mertonDecomp({ticker: sM.ticker, i1: cM.i1}, pM, gM.horizon, gM.seed)
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Precio al horizonte: Monte Carlo vs. lognormal sin saltos"
//| width: 50%
{
  const L = Float64Array.from(simM, p => Math.log(p[p.length - 1])), m = lib.mean(L), s = lib.sd(L);
  return lib2.termDist(simM, y => y > 0 ? Math.exp(-0.5 * ((Math.log(y) - m) / s) ** 2) / (y * s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) : 0, "Precio al horizonte (USD)", "Lognormal ajustada (sin saltos)");
}
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| width: 50%

  curves: [{name: "Parámetros calibrados", q: cM, line: {color: "#1f77b4", width: 2}}, {name: "Parámetros usados", q: pM, line: {color: "#d62728", width: 2, dash: "dot"}}]})
```

```{ojs}

//| width: 50%

```




```{ojs}
//| width: 50%
```


# Ornstein-Uhlenbeck

## {.sidebar}

**Calibración**

```{ojs}
viewof sO = Inputs.form({
  ticker: Inputs.select(tickers, {label: "Ticker"}),
  from: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar desde", value: dates[0], min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  to: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar hasta", value: "2023-12-31", min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)})
})
```

**Simulación**

```{ojs}
viewof gO = Inputs.form({
  horizon: Inputs.range([20, 504], {label: "Horizonte (días)", step: 1, value: 252}),
  n: Inputs.range([10, 1000], {label: "Trayectorias", step: 10, value: 200}),
  seed: Inputs.number({label: "Semilla", value: 42, step: 1})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cO = {
  const [i0, i1] = lib.between(sO.from, sO.to);
  return {i0, i1, ...lib.calibAR(prices[sO.ticker].slice(i0, i1 + 1).map(v => Math.log(v)))};
}
```

**Parámetros de la simulación** (arrancan en lo calibrado)

```{ojs}
viewof pO = Inputs.form({
  theta: Inputs.range([0.001, Math.max(3 * cO.kappa, 5)], {label: "θ (velocidad)", value: cO.kappa}),
  mu: Inputs.range([Math.min(cO.level, cO.lo) - 0.5, Math.max(cO.level, cO.hi) + 0.5], {label: "μ (nivel de ln P)", value: cO.level}),
  sigma: Inputs.range([0.1 * cO.sigma, 3 * cO.sigma], {label: "σ", value: cO.sigma})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
simO = lib.simMR(Math.log(prices[sO.ticker][cO.i1]), pO.theta, pO.mu, pO.sigma, gO.horizon, gO.n, gO.seed, Math.exp)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
rollO = lib3.rolling(prices[sO.ticker].map(v => Math.log(v)))
```

## Row

Modelo sobre el logaritmo del precio: `d ln P = θ(μ − ln P)dt + σ dW`, es decir, el precio nunca es negativo y revierte a `exp(μ)`. **Calibración:** regresión MCO `xₜ₊₁ = a + b·xₜ + ε` con `x = ln P`; `θ = −ln(b)/Δt`, `μ = a/(1−b)`, `σ = s_ε·√(2θ/(1−b²))`. **Simulación:** esquema exacto del proceso desde el último precio de la ventana, transformado con `exp`. En series con tendencia `b ≈ 1` y la reversión es débil o inexistente: la calibración lo muestra tal cual.

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Calibración: regresión ln Pₜ₊₁ sobre ln Pₜ"
//| width: 65%
lib.arFigure(cO, "ln Pₜ", "ln Pₜ₊₁")
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Parámetros"
//| width: 35%

  ["θ (velocidad)", lib.fmt(cO.kappa), lib.fmt(pO.theta)],
  ["μ (ln P)", lib.fmt(cO.level), lib.fmt(pO.mu)],
  ["exp(μ) (USD)", lib.fmt(Math.exp(cO.level)), lib.fmt(Math.exp(pO.mu))],
  ["σ", lib.fmt(cO.sigma), lib.fmt(pO.sigma)],
  ["Vida media (días)", lib.fmt(Math.log(2) / cO.kappa * 252), lib.fmt(Math.log(2) / pO.theta * 252)],
  ["b (AR1)", lib.fmt(cO.b), ""],
  ["R²", lib.fmt(cO.r2), ""],
  ["Reversión", cO.reverting ? "sí" : "no (b ≥ 1)", ""]
])
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Simulación Monte Carlo vs. precio real"
lib.simFigure({ticker: sO.ticker, i0: cO.i0, i1: cO.i1, level: Math.exp(pO.mu), levelName: "exp(μ)", paths: simO})
```

## Row

```{ojs}

//| width: 50%

```

```{ojs}
  const T = gO.horizon / 252, x0 = Math.log(prices[sO.ticker][cO.i1]), k = Math.max(pO.theta, 1e-6);
  const m = pO.mu + (x0 - pO.mu) * Math.exp(-k * T), s = pO.sigma * Math.sqrt((1 - Math.exp(-2 * k * T)) / (2 * k));
  return lib2.termDist(simO, y => y > 0 ? Math.exp(-0.5 * ((Math.log(y) - m) / s) ** 2) / (y * s * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI)) : 0, "Precio al horizonte (USD)", "Lognormal analítica");
}
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Primer cruce del nivel de equilibrio exp(μ): probabilidad acumulada"
//| width: 50%

```

```{ojs}
//| width: 50%

```

## Row

```{ojs}

lib3.fanExact({ticker: sO.ticker, i1: cO.i1, steps: gO.horizon, tf: Math.exp,
  mf: t => pO.mu + (Math.log(prices[sO.ticker][cO.i1]) - pO.mu) * Math.exp(-Math.max(pO.theta, 1e-6) * t),
  sf: t => pO.sigma * Math.sqrt((1 - Math.exp(-2 * Math.max(pO.theta, 1e-6) * t)) / (2 * Math.max(pO.theta, 1e-6)))})
```

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Probabilidad de que el precio al horizonte supere el actual, según exp(μ) y θ"
//| width: 50%
lib3.mrHeat({x0: Math.log(prices[sO.ticker][cO.i1]), kappa: pO.theta, level: pO.mu, sigma: pO.sigma, T: gO.horizon / 252, P0: prices[sO.ticker][cO.i1], toState: Math.log, toPrice: Math.exp})
```

# Herding: activos

## {.sidebar}

**Muestra**

```{ojs}
viewof sA = Inputs.form({
  tk: Inputs.checkbox(tickers, {label: "Activos del universo", value: tickers}),
  from: Inputs.date({label: "Desde", value: dates[0], min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  to: Inputs.date({label: "Hasta", value: dates.at(-1), min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  W: Inputs.range([40, 250], {label: "Ventana móvil (días)", step: 5, value: 120})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cA = {
  const [i0, i1] = lib.between(sA.from, sA.to);
  const tks = sA.tk.length >= 3 ? sA.tk : tickers;
  const s = lib2.csadSeries(tks, i0, i1);
  return {s, tks, f: lib2.herdFit(s), W: Math.max(20, Math.min(sA.W, s.T - 20))};
}
```

## Row

Modelo de Chang, Cheng y Khorana (2000): `CSADₜ = α + γ₁·|Rₘ,ₜ| + γ₂·Rₘ,ₜ² + εₜ`, donde `CSADₜ = (1/N)·Σ|rᵢ,ₜ − Rₘ,ₜ|` es la dispersión absoluta transversal de los retornos y `Rₘ,ₜ` el retorno equiponderado del universo. **Idea:** sin manada, la dispersión crece linealmente con |Rₘ| (los activos reaccionan de forma distinta al mercado); con manada, en días de movimientos fuertes los inversionistas imitan al consenso, la dispersión se comprime y `γ₂ < 0`. Los t-valores usan errores de Newey-West (5 rezagos); se declara manada si `t(γ₂) < −1,645`. El panel móvil muestra cuándo aparece y se contrasta con la correlación media entre activos. Con solo 10 acciones de gran capitalización el test tiene poca potencia: úsalo como ilustración del método, no como prueba concluyente.

```{ojs}
//| width: 50%
lib2.herdScatter(cA.s, cA.f)
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Coeficientes (t de Newey-West entre paréntesis)"
//| width: 50%
lib2.herdTables(cA.f)
```


```{ojs}
//| width: 50%

```



# Herding: opciones

## {.sidebar}

**Calibración**

```{ojs}
viewof sH = Inputs.form({
  ticker: Inputs.select(tickers, {label: "Ticker"}),
  from: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar desde", value: dates[0], min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  to: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar hasta", value: "2023-12-31", min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)})
})
```

**Simulación**

```{ojs}
viewof gH = Inputs.form({
  horizon: Inputs.range([20, 504], {label: "Vencimiento (días)", step: 1, value: 63}),
  n: Inputs.range([200, 3000], {label: "Trayectorias", step: 100, value: 1000}),
  seed: Inputs.number({label: "Semilla", value: 42, step: 1}),
  r: Inputs.range([0, 0.1], {label: "Tasa libre de riesgo", step: 0.005, value: 0.04})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cHo = {
  const [i0, i1] = lib.between(sH.from, sH.to), p = prices[sH.ticker].slice(i0, i1 + 1);
  const r = p.slice(1).map((v, i) => Math.log(v / p[i]));
  return {i0, i1, S0: p[p.length - 1], sigma: lib.sd(r) * Math.sqrt(252)};
}
```

**Parámetros del modelo de manada**

```{ojs}
viewof pHo = Inputs.form({
  N: Inputs.range([20, 300], {label: "N (agentes)", step: 10, value: 100}),
  eps: Inputs.range([0.0001, 0.02], {label: "ε (cambio autónomo, diario)", step: 0.0001, value: 0.001}),
  h: Inputs.range([0.01, 0.5], {label: "h (imitación, diario)", step: 0.01, value: 0.2}),
  beta: Inputs.range([0, 3], {label: "β (sesgo del drift)", step: 0.05, value: 1.5}),
  kappa: Inputs.range([0, 2], {label: "κ (amplif. de volatilidad)", step: 0.05, value: 0.5}),
  sigma: Inputs.range([0.05, Math.max(1, 2 * cHo.sigma)], {label: "σ base", value: cHo.sigma})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
simHo = lib2.simHerd(cHo.S0, {...pHo, r: gH.r}, gH.horizon, gH.n, gH.seed)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
hpHo = lib2.herdPrices(simHo.paths, cHo.S0, gH.horizon / 252, gH.r, pHo.sigma)
```

## Row

Modelo de Kirman (1993) en la versión de Alfarano, Lux y Wagner: `N` agentes, cada uno optimista (1) o pesimista (0). Cada día un agente cambia de bando con probabilidad `ε + h·(fracción del bando contrario)`: `ε` es el cambio autónomo e `h` la imitación. El **índice de manada** `N·ε/h` decide el régimen: si es menor que 1, la fracción de optimistas `x` es bimodal (consensos extremos y largos). El sentimiento `m = 2x − 1` mueve el drift (`β·m`) y amplifica la volatilidad (`σ·(1 + κ|m|)`). Las opciones se valoran por Monte Carlo corrigiendo la martingala (`E[S_T] = S₀·e^{rT}`) y la sonrisa de volatilidad sale de la mezcla de regímenes de sentimiento. Es una valoración ilustrativa: el repositorio no tiene precios de opciones para contrastarla.

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Fracción de optimistas xₜ en 6 trayectorias"
//| width: 65%
lib2.herdX(simHo.xs)
```

```{ojs}
//| title: "Parámetros y diagnóstico"
//| width: 35%
{
  const idx = pHo.N * pHo.eps / pHo.h, T = gH.horizon / 252;
  const r = Array.from(simHo.paths, p => Math.log(p[p.length - 1] / cHo.S0)), mo = lib2.moments(r);
  return lib.table(["", "Valor"], [
    ["Índice de manada N·ε/h", lib.fmt(idx)],
    ["Régimen de x", idx < 1 ? "bimodal (manada fuerte)" : "unimodal (sin manada)"],
    ["σ base calibrado", lib.fmt(cHo.sigma)],
    ["σ base usado", lib.fmt(pHo.sigma)],
    ["Asimetría del retorno terminal", lib.fmt(mo.skew)],
    ["Curtosis en exceso", lib.fmt(mo.kurt)],
    ["Factor de corrección martingala", lib.fmt(hpHo.adj)],
    ["Vencimiento (años)", lib.fmt(T)]
  ]);
}
```


# Opciones reales

## {.sidebar}

**Opción real y riesgo**

```{ojs}
viewof sR = Inputs.form({
  kind: Inputs.select(new Map([["Diferir la inversión (call americana)", "defer"], ["Expandir (call sobre el incremento)", "expand"], ["Abandonar (put americana)", "abandon"]]), {label: "Opción real"}),
  ticker: Inputs.select(tickers, {label: "Proxy de riesgo (ticker)"}),
  from: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar σ desde", value: dates[0], min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)}),
  to: Inputs.date({label: "Calibrar σ hasta", value: "2023-12-31", min: dates[0], max: dates.at(-1)})
})
```

**Mercado y retículo**

```{ojs}
viewof gR = Inputs.form({
  T: Inputs.range([0.5, 10], {label: "Plazo de la opción T (años)", step: 0.5, value: 3}),
  N: Inputs.range([10, 200], {label: "Pasos del retículo", step: 5, value: 50}),
  r: Inputs.range([0, 0.15], {label: "Tasa libre de riesgo", step: 0.005, value: 0.04}),
  d: Inputs.range([0, 0.15], {label: "δ (rendimiento de flujos, costo de esperar)", step: 0.005, value: 0.04})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
cR = {
  const [i0, i1] = lib.between(sR.from, sR.to), p = prices[sR.ticker].slice(i0, i1 + 1);
  return {i0, i1, sigma: lib.sd(p.slice(1).map((v, i) => Math.log(v / p[i]))) * Math.sqrt(252)};
}
```

**Parámetros del proyecto** (σ arranca en lo calibrado)

```{ojs}
viewof pR = Inputs.form({
  V0: Inputs.range([10, 300], {label: "V₀ (valor presente de los flujos)", step: 1, value: 100}),
  K: Inputs.range([10, 300], {label: "K (inversión / costo de expandir / valor de rescate)", step: 1, value: {defer: 100, expand: 60, abandon: 80}[sR.kind]}),
  f: Inputs.range([1.05, 2.5], {label: "f (factor de expansión)", step: 0.05, value: 1.5}),
  sigma: Inputs.range([0.05, Math.max(1, 2 * cR.sigma)], {label: "σ del proyecto", value: cR.sigma})
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
qR = {
  return {V0: pR.V0, K: pR.K, f: pR.f, T: gR.T, r: gR.r, d: gR.d, s: pR.sigma, N: gR.N};
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
vR = lib2.critical(sR.kind, qR)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
sensR = lib2.realSens(sR.kind, qR)
```

## Row

Opciones reales (Dixit y Pindyck; Trigeorgis): la flexibilidad gerencial se valora como una opción financiera sobre el valor presente `V` de los flujos del proyecto, que sigue un movimiento browniano geométrico con volatilidad `σ` y rendimiento `δ`. **Diferir**: call americana con precio de ejercicio `K` (la inversión); esperar tiene valor porque se puede invertir solo si `V` sube, y el umbral `V*` es mayor que `K`. **Expandir**: se paga `K` para obtener `(f − 1)·V` adicional. **Abandonar**: put americana con precio de ejercicio `K` (valor de rescate). El valor se calcula en un retículo binomial CRR con ejercicio anticipado; para diferir se muestra además el umbral perpetuo de McDonald-Siegel `V* = β/(β−1)·K`. La volatilidad se calibra con los retornos del ticker elegido como proxy del riesgo del proyecto.
